scope: First-party AI-assisted API/source review only; no fresh successful SDK verification or external security certification.
verified_invariants: SDK load_from_host hashes the same immutable host Bytes against compiled exact SHA256 after exact length check and before its guest Vec copy or nested decoding.
Private decode has no exported request-selected hash or bypass; exact original native source identity and complete bounded/canonical loader checks retained.
Actual SDK contract remains fixed public fixture, no account/asset mutation, backend_available false; generic binding component is separate mathematical validation.

CanonicalEd25519PublicKey certifies only canonical nonidentity prime-subgroup point encoding; expected identity must come from trusted account state. Scalar clamping guard precedes trusted group multiplication and exact canonical-byte equality.
No seed preimage, full recovery request, current-policy or one-time transition is established by generic point binding.
limits: 400M/12B CPU exhaustion is failed execution, never valid proof rejection.
Raw module size fit is not SDK contract ABI, actual SDK code-size fit, whole host+guest memory or instruction feasibility.
No approval of quantum knowledge/ZK composition or complete backend security.
